rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for meat from cattle or other bovines.

example.english: The beef at this restaurant is very tender.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ngau4 juk6 hou2 nyun6

rows.note: Use this for dissatisfaction or a grievance toward a person or thing.

example.english: I have some beef with the arrangement.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 go3 on1 paai4 jau5 di1 bat1 mun5

rows.note: Use this for physical strength, force, or potency rather than literal meat.

example.english: This machine really has a lot of beef.
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gei1 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 lik6

rows.note: Use this for the important substance or key point of a document, discussion, or project.

example.english: The main beef of this report is the plan to cut costs.
example.traditional: 呢份報告嘅重點係要削減成本。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 zung6 dim2 hai6 jiu3 soek3 gaam2 sing4 bun2
